---
name: bmad-correct-course
description: Reassess a feature or implementation when requirements, constraints, or evidence have changed. Use when asked to change direction or recover a project that is off track.
---

# Correct course

Summarize the intended outcome, current implementation/evidence, and changed
constraint. Identify what remains useful, what should be adjusted, and any
migration or data implications. Propose the smallest revised path and ask before
destructive or externally visible actions. Do not revert unrelated work.
